name: [UPD] Poison Sushi Challenge !🍣
desc:
💀 Welcome to Poison Sushi Challenge!🍣
The funniest sushi survival mini-game on Roblox! now inspired by bomb chip mind games!

👉 Sit at the table, choose your sushi… and hope it’s not poisoned or a hidden bomb 💣
👉 Win rounds to unlock RARE and LEGENDARY Chopstick skins 🔥
👉 Play with friends in this social, crazy, hilarious challenge full of surprises!

✨ Features:

Hilarious sushi survival gameplay (poison & bomb style – choose wisely!)

Inspired by bomb chip / bomb selection games, reworked with sushi

Funny animations and wild visual effects 💀😂

Gacha box system with RARE chopsticks to collect

Multiplayer fun – challenge and beat your friends

Like Poison Candy, Drink the Poison, and Bomb Chip games, but more social and more stylish.

🎮 Are you brave enough to survive the poisoned & bomb sushi challenge?
Play now!
